name: Stimulants
summary: Stimulants is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Most stimulants exert their activating effects by enhancing catecholamine neurotransmission. Catecholamine neurotransmitters are employed in regulatory pathways implicated in attention, arousal, motivation, task salience and reward anticipation. Classical stimulants either block the reuptake or stimulate the efflux of these catecholamines, resulting in increased activity of their circuits.

uses.text: Stimulants are widely used throughout the world as prescription medicines as well as without a prescription (either legally or illicitly) as performance-enhancing or recreational drugs. Stimulants produce a noticeable crash or comedown at the end of their effects. In the US, the most frequently prescribed stimulants as of 2013 were lisdexamfetamine (Vyvanse), methylphenidate (Ritalin), and amphetamine (Adderall).
uses.recreational: Stimulants enhance the activity of the central and peripheral nervous systems. Common effects may include increased alertness, awareness, wakefulness, endurance, productivity and motivation, arousal, locomotion, heart rate and blood pressure, and a diminished desire for food and sleep. Use of stimulants may cause the body to reduce significantly its production of natural body chemicals that fulfill similar functions.

zhOther: 中樞神經興奮劑, 中樞神經刺激劑
zhHansOther: 中枢神经兴奋剂, 中枢神经刺激剂
summaryZh: 興奮劑又稱為中樞神經興奮劑、中樞神經刺激劑、精神興奮劑，是一類具有興奮中樞神經系統功能，使機體器官組織的生理、生化功能增強的藥劑，其中包括可以興奮大腦皮質增加活動力、刺激延髓呼吸中樞，以及興奮脊髓以增強骨骼肌的緊張度的藥物。
summaryZhHans: 兴奋剂又称为中枢神经兴奋剂、中枢神经刺激剂、精神兴奋剂，是一类具有兴奋中枢神经系统功能，使机体器官组织的生理、生化功能增强的药剂，其中包括可以兴奋大脑皮质增加活动力、刺激延髓呼吸中枢，以及兴奋脊髓以增强骨骼肌的紧张度的药物。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include a racing heart, raised blood pressure, poor sleep, loss of appetite, anxiety and a crash afterwards. Heavy or repeated use can lead to dependence, paranoia or psychosis, and overdose can cause overheating, heart rhythm problems, stroke or seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 常見的影響包括心跳加速、血壓上升、失眠、食慾下降、焦慮，以及藥效過後的低落感。大量或反覆使用可能導致依賴、妄想或精神病，過量則可能造成體溫過高、心律不整、中風或癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见的影响包括心跳加速、血压上升、失眠、食欲下降、焦虑，以及药效过后的低落感。大量或反复使用可能导致依赖、妄想或精神病，过量则可能造成体温过高、心律不整、中风或癫痫发作。

fact.en: Caffeine, the most widely used stimulant in the world, is made by coffee, tea and cacao plants partly as a natural pesticide that deters insects.
fact.zh: 咖啡因是全世界使用最廣的興奮劑，咖啡、茶與可可植物製造它的原因之一，是用來當作驅趕昆蟲的天然殺蟲劑。
fact.zhHans: 咖啡因是全世界使用最广的兴奋剂，咖啡、茶与可可植物制造它的原因之一，是用来当作驱赶昆虫的天然杀虫剂。
